description: Rehearse a database migration by creating a disposable snapshot, executing the migration, capturing the baseline, and verifying the postconditions.
body_source:
context = validate_approved_plan(plan)
if not context:
    return context

snapshot = create_test_snapshot(context)
if not snapshot:
    return snapshot

baseline = capture_baseline(context)
if not baseline:
    return baseline

execute_migration(context)
if not context:
    return context

verify_postconditions(context)
if not context:
    return context

report = build_evidence_report(context)
return report
